'''2016 MPC Josh Mack LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Josh Mack]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
